title: Camp features
description: What a camp offers: facilities, activities, accommodation attributes, and program models (multi-valued on camp.features). ONE namespace holds both widely-shared features and long-tail differentiators, so a rare draw like land sailing is as filterable as a dining hall. Each term may carry `category` (what kind of thing it is), `broader` (a coarser parent, so specific leaves answer general queries), and `aliases` (synonyms absorbed during curation, not valid data values). Seeded from camp-finder.

terms.description: Step-free or wheelchair-accessible campsites, buildings, and programme areas.
